name: Rustboro City
lines:
Way back in the old days, Devon
was just a teeny-tiny company.

My daddy works at Devon.
This here’s something he made!
I can’t use it, so you can have it.

My daddy works at Devon.
When I grow up, I’m gonna
go work there, too!

My dad’s a real ace in the Devon
Corporation, I’ll have you know!
It’s no wonder I’m an ace myself!
Here. I’ll give you something that
an Ace Trainer like me uses!

If you have a Pokémon hold a Float Stone,
its weight will be halved.
Although it looks like it’ll be a while before you
can use something like this as well as I can.

...
For some reason, I’ve put on
a lot of weight recently.
